treatment: Exact prior test-only Packed body, byte-identical; unchanged production JA/SW guards/pack/readings/recognitions and masks. No promotion.

density.actual_android: Record existing Compose Slider(valueRange=0f..0.75f,steps=14) callbacks via SetProgress for nominal Float requests; preserve exact returned Float→Double bits, no app preferences.

evaluation.parity: Every .25 direct A/B/trace exactly equals retained completed comparison. No interpretation credited unless all 768 pass.
evaluation.representation: JSONL source/state record once, content-addressed unique output/full mixed/spans/references and evidence objects; exact density bits map to objects plus actual budget. No silent alternative truncation.
evaluation.scope: Actual native starter packing + core presentation directly. Prior .25 normal route parity reused. This is not Swift execution or new whole-routing/transport qualification.
evaluation.empty: Zero at density0 and all-concept exclusions; not counted as quality observations.
evaluation.asymmetry: JA selected IDs family/books/music retain unmatched family; SW families/books/music. Both frozen.

review.novel_unit: pair+sourceID+exactUTF16 scope+target+reading not present in same source at any prior .25 exclusion state; report state-specific newly exposed units separately
review.novel_combinations: Every unique full mixed output retained, even if its constituent units were previously reviewed.
review.packet: Full source/mixed/options with variant ID and density labels; no parallel translations. Separate provenance/evidence sidecar. Review all genuinely novel occurrence contexts; no count of repeated empty density rows as validation.
review.no_tuning: No content, guard, rank or source changes from output; only retain/correct harness failures explicitly.

bounds.capture_reservation: Measured APK+2*DEX+retained boot/output reserves, fresh capacity admission.
bounds.basis: Prior 768-row full-route comparison119.86s included repeated whole-report rewrites and normal-route calls. This pass removes report rewrites and routing, bounds at most32 densities×768 direct native calls, and retains one compact JSONL record per source/state.
